newsitem.title: USA: RUSS BERRIE CUTS 100 WORKERS DUE TO UPS STRIKE.
newsitem.headline: RUSS BERRIE CUTS 100 WORKERS DUE TO UPS STRIKE.

text.p: Russ Berrie and Co Inc said the strike at United Parcel Service of America Inc has reduced its ability to ship goods, forcing it to cut 100 part-time and temporary workers.
Russ Berrie, which designs and markets "impulse gifts", said the workers were laid off on Friday. Russ Berrie's total number of workers was not immediately available.

"At this time of year, we're shipping a lot of seasonal and Christmas items. We can't find enough sources to get out the products," said Curts Cooke, Russ Berrie's president and chief operating officer. "We're getting out about 20 to 30 percent of our normal shipments," Cooke said.
If the UPS strike were resolved, the employees would likely be rehired when shipping levels returned to normal, Cooke said.
Cooke said he could not estimate whether the strike and shipping delays would affect revenues or earnings.
"It's impossible to forecast at this time," Cooke said.
The Teamsters strike at UPS entered its tenth day, with no face-to-face talks between the union and the package delivery company scheduled for Wednesday.
